verdict.rationale: Sierra lets users define workflows and journeys, in no-code Studio, the code SDK, or Ghostwriter, that agents then run autonomously across chat, phone, email and SMS. Explorer also delivers a weekly briefing automatically without being asked, which is a built-in background behaviour. However, the agents mainly react to customer conversations, and nothing shows users setting up their own scheduled or event-triggered background jobs. Missing for 10: user-configurable scheduled/triggered background automations, documentation of unattended non-conversational task execution, independent hands-on corroboration.
